rawContent: Did you hear there were 1,500 cars in our Car Rally for Black Lives last Saturday? Jointly sponsored with @NAACPClarkCo, we are proud to have so many supporters show up in the ‘Couve for this cause. Ya'll made the news. Check it! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/zUYocGdHm3 https://t.co/tmyZ0YkrTK
Do you know the three women who started the #BlackLivesMatter movement 7 years ago? Check out this article from @JamilSmith at @RollingStone.  https://t.co/rNRdvG3K7g https://t.co/V5y6fZs0LP

Want to be an ally in the @BlackLivesMatter movement, but aren't sure how? 1st - acknowledge your blind spots -  We all have implicit biases. That’s OK to admit! We can’t change our prejudices until we address that we have them in the first place.
#BlackLivesMatter #implicitbias https://t.co/NoVMTeVRNS
